scope: Work at one common matching scale with canonical matter normalization. Hold the five tree edges as separate real monomials; allow arbitrarily many real holomorphic terms on the complex edge, using the sum of absolute Wilson coefficients on each edge. Scalar rates use the infinitesimal pure X response with known real aligned doublet contribution, massless final-state kinematics and fixed flavor labels. The projections are an illustrative conditional test, not fitted Higgs parameters.
